quantity: The do-nothing re-gating share r = (L01 - L00) / (T1 - T0) per fine-tuned state (run.py docstring): log-odds of the window's target token at the last position, T the target model (W0, then the whole fine-tune), L the CI-masked model with W0's subcomponents and all W0 weights, Delta out, under Gamma's gates from W0's forward (L00) or the fine-tune's (L01). Windows per E137 pair: the first 2048 of the pair's read half where F's top token differs from M's; target F's top token. r is nan when T1 - T0 < 1 (local_faith.MIN_GAIN).

groups.E137's hand-made changes: does not apply: forward hooks, no weight change, nothing saved

spread_source: experiments/method_table/results/final.json, jq '.cells[] | select(.method=="share") | .reuse, .new': the largest seed sd of the 67M share over the 26 sides of the 13 scorecard pairs (0.0405, e125_repeat_label reuse side; largest over built sides 0.024, pooled built 0.014). The largest is used.
rule: Always on's finite shares pooled over both recipes (n_a up to 6) against each rewiring group's finite shares (n_b up to 3). d = mean(Always on) - mean(other). bar = 2 * 0.0405 * sqrt(1/n_a + 1/n_b) (0.057 at 6 against 3, 0.066 at 3 against 3, 0.081 at 2 against 2). Call 'higher' if d >= bar, 'lower' if d <= -bar, else 'within the bar'. 'unreadable' if either side has fewer than 2 finite shares (a state with gain under 1, or a Cue seed stopped at step 10, has none). Absolute difference of shares, not relative.

P1.text: Always on reads a higher share than Table (the user's expectation, 2026-11-17).
P1.else: 'unreadable' is reported as such and is neither

P2.text: Always on reads a higher share than Cue (the user's expectation, 2026-11-17).
P2.else: 'unreadable' is reported as such and is neither

expected.identity control (stage 0, alone, first): gain T1 - T0 = 0, L01 - L00 = 0 and the largest gate change = 0 on each of the four pairs' windows, within 1e-06 (same forwards on the same inputs; no measured floor needed, the value is 0 by construction and 1e-06 is a millionth of the gain floor); r undefined. A miss stops the job.

Floor: E136's stage 0 (experiments/share_untrained/results/stage0.json, e_rows) re-read this state through route_split with difference 0, and its largest difference between two code paths reading one saved state was 1.37e-4 (class_twin_definition_verify); 0.001 is about 7 times that. This path differs from route_split only in loading every weight and reading L01 with W0's target weights, which do not enter the Delta-out masked forward, so 0 is expected. A miss (or nan) is exit 1.
expected.Always on: r between 0.3 and 0.8 if rival A holds; at or under Table's if much of the push sits in the embeddings (size.other against size.decomposed in stage2.json says where it sits). Gain over 1 on every state (E139: the fine-tunes reach a KL to F of 0.02 against 0.14 at M).
expected.Table: r between 0.1 and 0.45, the trained pairs' new-side range, if rival A holds; gain well over 1 (F moves the keyed answers by KL 6.5).
expected.Cue: step 10 KL(F||ft) about 0.018 against a start of 0.038 (E139's three seeds, same recipe and seeds), so the corrected check passes; r as Table's under rival A.
expected.XOR: gain probably under 1 (E139: not learned), r nan; shown only.

edge_cases_checked: verdicts() run on the CPU worker before filing, 2026-11-17 (scratch p233-writer/edges.py, output edges.log): empty pools, one finite value a side, all-nan Always on (the do-nothing state: gain 0, r nan), d exactly at the bar, d just under the bar, a reversal, a passing case and a missing Cue group. Empty, one-a-side and all-nan pools read 'unreadable' (so the do-nothing state cannot pass); d at the bar reads 'higher' after both are rounded to 9 decimals (the first try read 'within the bar' from float rounding, so the rounding was added); 1e-6 under reads 'within the bar' (miss); a reversal reads 'lower' (miss); a missing or two-stopped Cue group leaves P2 'unreadable' and P1 read.
blind_to: The share sees only what Gamma's gates on W0's subcomponents carry; a change stored in the embeddings, norms or unembedding (not decomposed) lowers r whatever the built kind. It reads 2048 changed-answer windows per pair at the last position only, and F's top token only.
not_a_definition_change: No reuse verdict is given; the frozen reuse definition (decisions.md rows 81 and 87) is not read or touched. The share is the method being scored against the built kinds.
